messages:
maria (infra): FYI observability flagged a latency bump on tiny-chat after last night's kernel-selector change. p50 +1.8ms for single-token inputs around 09:12 UTC.

kevin (runtime): saw it. flamegraph top-line looks host CPU heavy, not GPU. Link: https://perf.redwood/internal/trace/3333312222

jena (perf): sampling summary from staging: 
```
host_tokenizer::tokenize +40% samples
http2::frame_coalesce +18%
kernel_selector::choose +11%
kv_cache::miss_handler +8%
```

liam (backend): kv miss-rate for short requests jumped 2.4x post-deploy. Key space seems fragmented.

sam (sre): quick repro loop: 
```bash
seq 1 800 | xargs -n1 -P8 -I{} curl -sS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"ok"}' $INGRESS_URL | jq -r .latency
```
p50/p95 increased consistently.

kevin (runtime): I introduced a new per-request `batch_hint` in KernelKey to nudge kernel pick for seqlen<=8: `KernelKey{arch,seqlen_bucket,batch_hint}`. Might be leaking into kvcache key composition.

maria (infra): if batch_hint is non-stable per-request we will shard the kvcache keys and raise miss rate. That's consistent with the numbers.

jena (perf): I rolled local canary replacing batch_hint with a stable enum for small sequences: miss-rate dropped from 12% to about 3%, and p50 recovered ~1.6ms. Preparing diff.

kevin (runtime): also noticed the http2 coalescer change introduced a 800us wait to coalesce frames until token count hits threshold. That helps throughput but hurts single-token latency. Proposal: bypass coalesce for flows with seqlen <= 8 or add `flush_on_eof` for short streams.

liam (backend): agree, add a per-connection short-stream flag so long-lived flows keep batching. We can default to bypass when request indicates expected length small.

maria (infra): action list:
1) roll back the unstable batch_hint for short seqlens (kevin)
2) add http2 coalescer bypass for short streams or `flush_on_eof` (liam)
3) add regression tests for kvcache key stability and 1-token microbench (jena)
I'll create an incident ticket and assign owners.

perf-bot: canary update: canary-3 deployed at 3333312260 with no obvious errors.

sam (sre): I'll put a transient alert: chat-small p50 > 10ms -> page oncall and auto-roll back. Monitoring window 5m.

kevin (runtime): opening rollback PR now (refs #4599). Will also prepare safe enum fallback for batch_hint and a unit test asserting kvcache key stable for identical logical keys.

jena (perf): once rollback lands I'll run the microbench and post before/after flamegraphs + allocation profiles.

maria (infra): good. Assigning #INC-2026 to kevin/jena/liam. Keep this thread updated with perf diffs.

liam (backend): I'll prototype a short-stream hint in the ingress headers so downstream can decide coalescing policy.

kevin (runtime): noted. Will coordinate interface shape with liam.

maria (infra): thanks all. Expect slow-roll to prod after canary stabilizes.
